title: Rust reading: 1,000,000 rows, shared strings
dataset: 10 columns per row: integers, strings (one unique per row), floats, a date/time and a boolean; 1M rows with a shared string table (52 MB file)
method: examples/read_bench.rs. The file is written by Hypaxel and read cell by cell, with a checksum over all values that every reader must match. Each run is in its own process; best of three.
notes: What stays in memory is the shared string table plus the current row; in this file the 1M unique strings are in the shared table.
reproduce:
cargo run --release -p hypaxel --example read_bench -- generate data.xlsx 1000000 shared
cargo run --release -p hypaxel --example read_bench -- hypaxel data.xlsx     # or calamine, calamine-stream
